c157018506.notes: Large printed fascia banner of a halal poultry shop in El Socorro, Trinidad (no camera location), shot from a moving car: motion blur and an oblique angle. 'Halaal Village' is in outlined script on a red arrow. A smaller line under it (looks like 'Next to El Socorro Masjid' plus a WhatsApp number) is too blurred to transcribe reliably and is omitted. Product lists ('FRESH CHICKEN / FARM DUCKS / LOCAL DUCKS / HARD FOWL', 'X-LAYERS / FRESH EGGS ...'), a red 'NO ENTRY' road sign and a chalkboard 'Farm Ducks / Local Ducks / X-LAYERS' are distractors.
